options.content:
# Tetragon Health

#### ℹ️ Provides high level health indicators on Tetragon components, including Kubernetes level checks such as whether components are in a running state (i.e. not Pending/Crashing etc).

panels.description: Tracks the number of Tetragon Agents that are not in the Running state.  This could indicate Pods that are crashing, cannot be scheduled (i.e. Pending), image pull issues etc.

targets.expr: count(kube_pod_status_phase{pod=~"tetragon-[0-9a-z]+", pod=~"$pod", phase!="Running", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", node=~"$node"} == 1 or kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{pod=~"tetragon-[0-9a-z]+", pod=~"$pod", reason=~"CrashLoopBackOff|ErrImagePull|ImagePullBackOff|Init:CrashLoopBackOff", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", node=~"$node"} > 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Agent Pods Not Running

panels.description: This is the total number of times Tetragon components have restarted in the given time range.

targets.expr: sum(increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{container="tetragon", pod=~"$pod", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", node=~"$node"}[$__range]))

sum(increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{container="tetragon-operator", pod=~"$pod", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", cluster=~"$cluster", node=~"$node"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Tetragon Pod Restarts Since

panels.description: Total events by type over interval

targets.expr: sum by(type) (increase(tetragon_events_total{job=~"$job", cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", node=~"$node"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Total Event Ratios

targets.expr: topk($k, floor(sum by (pod) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{container=~"tetragon.*", pod=~"$pod", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", node=~"$node"}[$__range]))))
sum by (type) (rate(tetragon_events_total{job=~"$job", cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))
topk($k, floor(increase(tetragon_ringbuf_perf_event_lost_total{pod=~"$pod", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", node=~"$node"}[$__range])))

topk($k, sum by (node, pod) (rate(tetragon_ringbuf_perf_event_lost_total{pod=~"$pod", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])))

options.content:
# BPF Map Health

Tetragon uses BPF maps as a datastore.

ℹ️ **These maps are fundamental to Tetragon's operation. If they reach capacity then related functionality may fail.**

targets.expr: sum(rate(tetragon_map_errors_total{pod=~"$pod", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])) by (map)

panels.description: Provides current "pressure" on BPF maps which act as data stores for Tetragon agents.  High pressure can indicate overutilization of BPF maps and may lead to degradation of functionality.

targets.expr: sum(tetragon_map_in_use_gauge{pod=~"$pod", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", node=~"$node"}) by (map, total)

panels.title: Map Utilization

targets.expr: sum by (map) (tetragon_map_in_use_gauge{pod=~"$pod", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", node=~"$node"})
sum by(map) (deriv(tetragon_map_in_use_gauge{pod=~"$pod", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", node=~"$node"}[$__interval]))

panels.description: Provides current "pressure" on BPF maps which act as data stores for Tetragon agents.  High pressure can indicate overutilization of BPF maps and may lead to degradation of functionality.

targets.expr: sum(tetragon_map_in_use_gauge{pod=~"$pod", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", node=~"$node"}) by (map, total)

panels.title: Map Utilization

panels.description:
This metric provides the 90th and 50th (i.e. median) percentile of Tetragon agent run-time scheduling.

This is related to CPU availability and utilization, high values or increases here denote in either throttling or lack of compute resources.

High sustained runtime will likely indicate problems with Tetragon functionality.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(go_sched_latencies_seconds_bucket{pod=~"tetragon-[0-9a-z]+", pod=~"$pod", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])) by (le))

histogram_quantile(0.50, sum(rate(go_sched_latencies_seconds_bucket{pod=~"tetragon-[0-9a-z]+", pod=~"$pod", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])) by (le))

panels.title: Tetragon Agent CPU Runtime Latency

panels.description: Total memory utilization of Tetragon Agent Pods

targets.expr: topk($k, sum(container_memory_working_set_bytes{container="tetragon", pod=~"$pod", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", node=~"$node"}) by (pod))

panels.title: Tetragon Agent Container Memory Utilization

panels.description: Provides top-k Tetragon Agent CPU utilization metrics.

targets.expr: topk($k, sum(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container="tetragon", pod=~"$pod", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])) by (pod))

panels.title: Tetragon Agent Container CPU Utilization

panels.description: Total memory utilization of Tetragon Agent Pods

targets.expr: topk($k, sum(container_memory_working_set_bytes{container="tetragon", pod=~"$pod", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", node=~"$node"}) by (node, pod))

panels.title: Tetragon Agent Container Memory Utilization

panels.description: Provides top-k Tetragon Agent CPU utilization metrics.

targets.expr: topk($k, sum(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container="tetragon", pod=~"$pod", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])) by (node, pod))

panels.title: Tetragon Agent Container CPU Utilization

panels.description:
This shows how close Tetragon workload Pods are to their set memory limits (if set).  By default Tetragon installs without explicit memory limits - in which case nothing should be shown here.

However if Tetragon has a memory limit set this will show how much of their limit Tetragon Pods are using.

Pods that hit their limit will be killed for running out of memory by the Linux host OS and can cause disruptions in functionality.

Consistently high values here should indicate that you may want to increase limits.

targets.expr: (sum by (pod)(container_memory_working_set_bytes{container="tetragon", pod=~"$pod", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", node=~"$node"})) / (sum by (pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{container="tetragon", pod=~"$pod", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", resource="memory", node=~"$node"}))

panels.title: Tetragon Agent Container Memory Limit Utilization

targets.expr: sum(rate(tetragon_errors_total{pod=~"$pod", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])) by (type)
sum by (error) (rate(tetragon_layer3_event_errors_total{pod=~"$pod", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))
{pod=~"tetragon.*", pod=~"$pod", namespace=~"$namespace", cluster=~"$cluster", node_name=~"$node"} |= `error`

options.content:
This section is intended for validating or debugging the DNS parser.

Note that some panels are not affected by the pod & namespace variables.

targets.expr: sum by (response, rcodes) (rate(tetragon_dns_total{job=~"$job", cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum(rate(tetragon_dns_cache_misses_total{job=~"$job", cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum(rate(tetragon_dns_cache_evictions_total{node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by(binary) (rate(tetragon_socket_stats_txsegs_total{job=~"$job", cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", node=~"$node", dstdns="", dstnamespace="", dstworkload="", dstpod=""}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: TCP TX Segments with Missing Destination Names by Binary

targets.expr: sum by(binary) (rate(tetragon_socket_stats_rxsegs_total{job=~"$job", cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", node=~"$node", dstdns="", dstnamespace="", dstworkload="", dstpod=""}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: TCP RX Segments with Missing Destination Names by Binary

targets.expr: count by(protocol, destination_name) (rate({pod=~"tetragon.*", pod=~"$pod", namespace=~"$namespace", cluster=~"$cluster", node_name=~"$node"} |= `"process_connect"` | json destination_name="process_connect.destination_names", destination_ip="process_connect.destination_ip", protocol="process_connect.protocol" | __error__=`` [$__interval]))

panels.title: Process Connect Events by Destination & Protocol

targets.expr: count by(protocol) (rate({pod=~"tetragon.*", pod=~"$pod", namespace=~"$namespace", cluster=~"$cluster", node_name=~"$node"} |= `"process_connect"` | json destination_name="process_connect.destination_names", destination_ip="process_connect.destination_ip", protocol="process_connect.protocol", destination_pod="process_connect.destination_pod.name" | destination_name = `` | destination_pod = `` | __error__=`` [$__interval]))

sum by(destination_ip, binary) (count_over_time({pod=~"tetragon.*", pod=~"$pod", namespace=~"$namespace", cluster=~"$cluster", node_name=~"$node"} |= `"process_connect"` | json destination_name="process_connect.destination_names", destination_ip="process_connect.destination_ip", protocol="process_connect.protocol", destination_pod="process_connect.destination_pod.name", binary="process_connect.process.binary" | destination_name = `` | protocol = `TCP` | destination_pod = `` | __error__=`` [$__range]))

panels.title: Missing TCP Destination Names by Binary & IP

targets.expr: sum by(destination_ip, binary) (count_over_time({pod=~"tetragon.*", pod=~"$pod", namespace=~"$namespace", cluster=~"$cluster", node_name=~"$node"} |= `"process_connect"` | json destination_name="process_connect.destination_names", destination_ip="process_connect.destination_ip", protocol="process_connect.protocol", destination_pod="process_connect.destination_pod.name", binary="process_connect.process.binary" | destination_name = `` | destination_pod = `` | protocol = `UDP` | __error__=`` [$__range]))

panels.title: Missing UDP Destination Names by Binary & IP

options.content:
This section is intended for validating or debugging the TLS parser.

Note that some panels are not affected by the pod & namespace variables.

targets.expr: sum by(error, continuation) (rate(tetragon_tls_errors_total{pod=~"$pod", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.description: Ratio of actual continuation events to expected

targets.expr: sum(rate(tetragon_tls_actual_continutation_events_total{pod=~"$pod", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum(rate(tetragon_tls_expected_continutation_events_total{pod=~"$pod", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Percent Completed Continuations

panels.description: Total TLS errors over the time range

targets.expr: sum by(error, continuation) (increase(tetragon_tls_errors_total{pod=~"$pod", namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"$job", cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", node=~"$node"}[$__range]))

panels.title: TLS Errors Total

targets.expr: sum by(cipher) (rate(tetragon_tls_handshakes_total{job=~"$job", cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by(sni_name) (rate(tetragon_tls_handshakes_total{job=~"$job", cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by(version) (rate(tetragon_tls_handshakes_total{job=~"$job", cluster=~"$cluster", instance=~"$instance", node=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))
